title: HtmlHeader
responsibility: Renders the native header element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlHeader.attributes
inputs.description: Native header attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlHeader.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native header element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlHeader
outputs.description: The actual native header element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
